patterns.component_structure: Functional components with TypeScript interfaces for props
patterns.provider_pattern: React Context with custom hooks (useToast pattern following useAuth)
patterns.styling_pattern: Tailwind CSS utility classes with dark mode support (dark: prefix)
patterns.variant_pattern: Component variants using discriminated unions (primary, secondary, success, warning, error)
patterns.accessibility: Semantic HTML, ARIA labels, keyboard navigation, screen reader support
patterns.animation: Smooth transitions using Tailwind transitions and transforms

existing_implementations.description: The application has existing UI components (Button, Modal, Input) and providers (AuthProvider, ThemeProvider) that follow specific patterns we must match
relevant_files: components/ui/button.tsx - Shows variant pattern and Tailwind styling approach
components/providers/auth-provider.tsx - Shows provider pattern with Context and custom hook
components/providers/providers.tsx - Shows how to integrate new providers into app
docs/COMPONENTS.md - Documents provider integration patterns and best practices
existing_implementations.provider_integration: New providers must be added to components/providers/providers.tsx in the correct order. ToastProvider should be added after ThemeProvider but before QueryClientProvider
existing_implementations.current_feedback_pattern: Currently uses inline div elements with role='alert' for error messages. Success messages are not shown. Messages disappear on navigation or component unmount.

problem_context.current_state: Error and success messages displayed inline within form components
pain_points: No positive feedback when actions succeed (e.g., product creation)
Error messages disappear when navigating away or when component unmounts
Inconsistent feedback patterns across different pages
Messages don't persist briefly after successful actions
problem_context.desired_state: Global toast notification system that provides consistent, non-intrusive feedback that persists briefly regardless of navigation

design_requirements.positioning: Fixed position, top-right corner of viewport
accessibility: ARIA live region for screen readers
design_requirements.dark_mode: Full dark mode support matching existing component patterns
